method: median of per-unit bat_v over the 2026-06-18 09:00-10:00 Sydney full-charge plateau (n>=20/unit); offset = consensus 4.17V - unit median
note: volts to ADD to a unit's raw device bat_v to remove its voltage-divider bias; recompute battery % from the corrected voltage. Two units (G378517,G375430) capped at +0.05 pending a bench check.
